battle_traits.name: Form Up
battle_traits.declare:
Pick a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR unit to use this ability, then pick 2 other visible friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR units wholly within 12" of it to be the targets.
The unit using this ability and the targets:
• cannot be under orders.
• must each be a different unit type.
battle_traits.effect: For the rest of the battle round, the unit using this ability and the targets are under orders.

options.name: Designer’s Note
options.text: 'Unit type' refers to the name of the warscroll (Core Rules, 4.0), e.g. 'Freeguild Cavalier-Marshal' or 'Cannonade Cogfort'.

battle_traits.name: Take Aim
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is under orders to use this ability.
battle_traits.effect: Pick 1 of that unit's ranged weapons. Add 1 to hit rolls for shooting attacks made with that weapon for the rest of the turn.

battle_traits.name: Sound the Attack
battle_traits.timing: Reaction: You declared a CHARGE ability for a unit that is under orders
battle_traits.effect: You can change the lowest D6 in the charge roll to match the highest D6.

battle_traits.name: Into Them, You Dogs!
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly HERO that is under orders to use this ability. That unit is the field officer for the rest of the turn. Then, pick 2 other visible friendly non-HERO units that are under orders and wholly within 12" of the field officer to be the targets.
battle_traits.effect: For the rest of the turn, the first time the field officer uses a FIGHT ability, you can pick a target that has not used a FIGHT ability this turn. That target is inspirited and the other target is emboldened.The inspirited target can be picked to use a FIGHT ability immediately after the FIGHT ability used by the field officer has been resolved. Then, if the emboldened target has not used a FIGHT ability this turn, it can be picked to use a FIGHT ability immediately after the inspirited target's FIGHT ability has been resolved.

battle_traits.name: Hurl Them Back!
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is under orders and in combat with an enemy unit that charged this turn to use this ability.
battle_traits.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of that unit's melee weapons.

abilities.name: To the Last
abilities.effect: Each time a friendly unit that is under orders uses the 'Rally' command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

abilities.name: Masters of the Arcane
abilities.effect: Add 1 to arcane manipulation rolls and banishment rolls for friendly WIZARDS that are under orders.

options.name: Designer’s Note
options.text: Wizards in this battletome use arcane manipulation rolls for a variety of powerful effects.

abilities.name: Throngs of the Faithful
abilities.timing: Reaction: Your opponent declared a FIGHT ability.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly SIGMARITE units that target the enemy unit using that FIGHT ability.

abilities.name: Dawnbringer Crusade
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-HERO CITIES OF SIGMAR INFANTRY unit wholly within friendly territory to use this ability.
abilities.effect:
If that unit is in combat, it can move 6". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but can only end that move in combat with units it was in combat with at the start of the move. It does not have to end the move in combat.
If that unit is not in combat, it can move 6". It cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

abilities.name: Canny Crews
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly Ironweld Great Cannon units to be the targets.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, each time the target uses a SHOOT ability, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, or 1 wound roll, or 1 random characteristic roll for the Damage characteristic

abilities.name: Front-Line Leader
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR HUMAN INFANTRY HERO to use this ability. Then, you can pick up to 1 friendly non-HERO HUMAN INFANTRY unit and up to 1 friendly HUMAN WAR MACHINE unit that are wholly within 12" of that HERO to be the targets.
abilities.effect: While the targets are wholly within 12" of that HERO, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target INFANTRY unit's melee weapons and the target WAR MACHINE unit's ranged weapons until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Have No Mercy
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Until the start of the next battle round, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR AELF units that target that enemy unit while it is damaged or has had any models slain in the same turn.

abilities.name: I've Seen Worse and Killed Better
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with any friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR DUARDIN units that did not charge this turn to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, other than the Companion weapon ability, weapon abilities for the target's combat attacks have no effect for the rest of the turn.

entries.name: Stentorian General
entries.effect: Subtract 1 from ward rolls for enemy units while they are in combat with any visible friendly units that are wholly within 12" of this unit and under orders.

entries.name: Beloved Leader
entries.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls applied by enemy abilities for attacks made by visible friendly units that are wholly within 12" of this unit and under orders.

entries.name: Grizzled Drillmaster
entries.effect: Other visible friendly units have WARD (6+) while they are wholly within 12" of this unit and under orders.

entries.name: Astute Tactician
entries.declare: Pick a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
entries.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to charge rolls for the target and add 2 to run rolls for the target.

entries.name: Draw Steel!
entries.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR HUMAN unit that charged this turn and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
entries.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

entries.name: Cosmopolitan Leader
entries.declare: Pick a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR INFANTRY or CAVALRY unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. If this unit is HUMAN, pick up to 3 eligible units to be the targets instead.
entries.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn:
• If the target is HUMAN, add 1 to wound rolls for the target's combat attacks.
• If the target is DUARDIN, add 1 to charge rolls for the target.
• If the target is AELF, add 3 to the target's control score.

entries.name: Pious Veteran
entries.effect: Each time you pick targets while declaring a PRAYER ability used by a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR PRIEST, if this unit is eligible to be picked, you can pick it to be an additional target

entries.name: Bristling Attitude
entries.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a CHARGE ability for a visible unit within 12" of this unit
entries.effect: Spend any number of rage dice. If your opponent's fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, roll X dice, where X is the number of rage dice spent. For each 3+, subtract 1 from the charge roll.

entries.name: Cosmopolitan Leader
entries.declare: Pick up to 3 visible friendly non‑WAR MACHINE SIGMARITE units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
entries.effect: Spend 1 rage dice for each target. If your opponent's fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, add 1 to wound rolls for each target's combat attacks until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: The Last Blade of Embergard
entries.effect: This unit can use this ability while it is in reserve. Pick 1 of this unit's non-Companion melee weapons. Add 2 to that weapon's Attacks characteristic and Rend characteristic for the rest of the battle.

entries.name: Bones of Saint Ignifus
entries.timing: Reaction: You declared a SPELL or PRAYER ability for a visible unit that is wholly within 12" of this unit and under orders
entries.effect: Add 1 to the casting roll or chanting roll for that ability.

entries.name: The Sphere Celestial
entries.declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a point on the battlefield within 1" of this unit and more than 3" from all other units (friendly and enemy) and terrain features to be the target point. Then, pick another visible friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR INFANTRY or CAVALRY HERO that is wholly within 18" of this unit and not in combat to be the target unit.
entries.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target unit and not in combat. Then, remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target point and not in combat. This unit and the target unit can use MOVE abilities in the following movement phase (this is an exception to Core Rules, 24.0).

entries.name: Prototype Arco-Combustor Uninhibitor
entries.effect:
For the rest of the turn:
• Add 3" to this unit's Move characteristic
• This unit can use SHOOT abilities even if it used a RETREAT ability in the same turn.
• No mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by RETREAT abilities.

entries.name: Emergency Bellows
entries.effect: Remove 1 of this unit's heat tokens.

entries.name: Grapple-net Launcher
entries.declare: If this unit did not charge this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit and that charged this turn to be the target.
entries.effect: Subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

entries.name: Twin-tailed Comet of Honour
entries.effect: While this unit has any champions, add 5 to this unit's control score.

entries.name: The Living City Cross
entries.effect: While this unit has any champions, subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit.

entries.name: Aqshian Order of Merit
entries.effect: While this unit has any champions, if an enemy unit in combat with this unit uses the 'Eruption of Fury' ability, when resolving attacks as part of that ability, on an unmodified hit roll of 6, do not inflict an additional D3 mortal damage on each unit in combat with that unit.

entries.name: Speed of the Twin-tailed Comet
entries.declare: Pick a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 3" to the Move characteristic of friendly non-WAR MACHINE CITIES OF SIGMAR units while they are wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

entries.name: Curse of Scorched Metal
entries.declare: Pick a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the first time the target uses an ATTACK ability, for each unmodified hit roll of 1 for an attack made by the target as part of that ATTACK ability, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target after that ATTACK ability has been resolved.

entries.name: High Star's Light
entries.declare: Pick a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

entries.name: Holy Aegis
entries.declare: Pick a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: If the chanting roll was 7+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to each target in each phase.

entries.name: Reckoning of Sinners
entries.declare: Pick a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, enemy units have a maximum control score of 1 while they are in combat with any of the targets.

entries.name: Benediction of the High Heavens
entries.declare: Pick a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Heal (D3) the target and the chanter. If the chanting roll was 7+, Heal (D3) each visible friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR unit wholly within 12" of the chanter instead.
